reading.body:
This Verizon Wireless facility on Molloy Street in Nashville has no published power specification, cooling capacity, or IT load figure. The operator does not publish technical specifications for this site as it does for customer-facing colocation properties, so its relevance to AI infrastructure cannot be assessed from available data.

Tennessee has 24 mapped data centers, of which only 4 have published megawatt figures totaling 12.13 MW. This facility's ranking at fifth by published capacity reflects an absence of published capacity rather than a measured position. The state remains a minor node in US AI-relevant infrastructure as tracked by operator disclosures.

Without specifications on power delivery, cooling, or rack density, this facility cannot be read as a binding constraint on AI scaling or as a facility likely to host training workloads. If Verizon publishes technical details for this site in the future, that data would determine whether it functions as colocation, network switching, or general-purpose compute infrastructure.
